subject: Follow-up: Hosted API evaluation & deployment options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-data.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 23:07:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: Hosted API evaluation & deployment options

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier - I enjoyed learning about Acme Data Systems' search augmentation use case. Quick recap from our call + recommended next steps for an evaluation on Hosted API:

1) Recap / recommended path
- Recommendation: start with Hosted API for the fastest evaluation loop (no infra to provision, quick onboarding, immediate SDKs and streaming). If you hit sustained throughput or strict data-residency needs, we can discuss Dedicated or Private next.
- Hosted covers text generation, chat, embeddings; supports streaming and tool calls we demoed.

2) Quickstart + endpoints
- Quickstart doc attached (redwood-quickstart-hosted-api.pdf) and link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/quickstart-hosted-api
- Primary endpoints: https://us.api.redwood.ai/v1 (US), https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1 (EU)
- Auth: API key header (Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>). We also support short-lived keys for session-based flows.

3) Rate limits & scaling
- Attached is the baseline rate-limits table (rate-limits-table.csv). For Hosted evals we can temporarily raise per-account limits. As a starting point: default account quotas are 60 requests/min with a burst to 180 requests/min and ~10k tokens/min throughput; we can increase this for a short evaluation.

4) Data & security notes
- Hosted uses Redwood-managed encryption keys by default. For customer-managed keys and private networking, Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) options are available.

5) Next steps
- Can you share expected steady-state RPS and peak burst (requests/min or tokens/sec)?
- Please confirm any compliance or residency requirements (you mentioned US-only data).
- If you want a technical deep dive, I can loop in Dev to discuss Dedicated/Private feasibility and timing.

If it helps, I can provision a Hosted eval project with increased rate limits and $5k of trial credits (short-term) once we get your expected traffic numbers.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachment: redwood-quickstart-hosted-api.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: rate-limits-table.csv (CSV)
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-data.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 01:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Hosted API evaluation & deployment options

Marissa,

Thanks - this is super helpful. A few clarifying questions from our side:

- Throughput: our ingestion pipeline would need ~80 RPS steady for generation endpoints, with short bursts up to ~120 RPS (bursts < 5 minutes). We also have some batch embedding jobs at off-peak times.
- Data residency: yes, US-only is a hard requirement for this workload (customer contractual requirement).
- Security: we need to understand how Hosted handles keys and whether we can use customer-managed keys (KMS). If not, what are the controls around key management and audit logs?
- SLA & cost: do you have a trial SLA? Also want a ballpark for cost if we keep this on Hosted for production (monthly usage-based).

Finally, we'll likely need a short technical call with your infra/dev team to confirm networking and integration patterns - happy for Dev to join.

--Jordan
Jordan Miles
Senior Product Manager, Search & Retrieval
Acme Data Systems
jordan.miles@acme-data.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-data.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 03:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Hosted API evaluation & deployment options

Jordan - great questions, thanks for the details. Answers below and some actionable next steps.

On throughput
- 80 RPS steady + 120 RPS bursts is within what we can support on Hosted for an evaluation. I recommend we temporarily raise your account quotas for the eval window - Dev, I copied you to confirm the best throttle profile and to help provision the limits.

On data residency & security
- Hosted: we run regional endpoints (US/EU) and can ensure data for requests routed to the US endpoint stays in our US region. For highly-sensitive regulated workloads that require customer-managed keys or air-gapped deployments, Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) are the options.
- Key management: Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; we provide encrypted-at-rest with access controls and audit logs. Customer-managed KMS/HSM support is available on Private and can be arranged for Dedicated in most cases - we'll scope this during the technical call.

On SLA & cost
- Trial: we can provision a Hosted eval with increased quotas and $5k in credits; trial SLA is best-effort but we commit to timely support during evals.
- Production pricing: usage-based (tokens + request units). I can pull together a rough estimate once you share expected token volumes (average prompt+generation length).

Quickstart snippet (curl)
- curl -X POST https://us.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"<your prompt>"}'

Next steps
- Jordan: please confirm the steady/peak RPS (you gave 80/120 - confirm tokens per request or an average characters/prompt) and we'll spin up the eval project.
- Dev: can you confirm the burst configuration and whether we can raise the Hosted quotas for a 2-week eval?
- If after the eval you need customer-managed keys or a stricter SLA, we can scope Dedicated sizing (minimums) or Private deployment.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call; what does your calendar look like next week?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Hosted API evaluation & deployment options

Hi Jordan + team,

Looping in a few technical details from the infra side:

- Hosted quota increases: we can temporarily raise request and token quotas for a 2-week eval window. For your stated 80 RPS steady / 120 RPS burst, we would configure a profile with a 150 RPS soft burst and a token allowance aligned to your average payloads. I can provision this once we have an expected tokens-per-request metric.
- Data residency: if you point at the US endpoint (https://us.api.redwood.ai/v1) we ensure processing and storage remain in our US regions. We also maintain request/audit logs for the account that we can surface for compliance reviews.
- Customer-managed keys / Dedicated / Private:
  - Dedicated reserved capacity: typically starts at a 3-month commit and a minimum of ~4 GPU-equivalents (we size by model and load). Dedicated supports customer KMS integration in most setups.
  - Private (VPC/on-prem): supports customer-managed HSM/KMS, private networking, and air-gapped options. Typical lead time for a full Private deployment is 6-8 weeks for procurement and setup.

What I need from you to move forward:
- Confirm average tokens per request (or sample prompt + generation size).
- Any compliance docs/questions to prioritize (SOC 2, data retention, audit log export).

Once we have those, I can: 1) provision the eval quotas, 2) enable the trial credits Marissa mentioned, and 3) prepare a short summary of Dedicated/Private handoff requirements if you think you might move there after eval.

Thanks,

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0199
